rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the robot's energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires, there must be a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and the gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever it drives forward by some distance, the free clearance ahead minus that distance must be at least 80 pixels, and whenever it drives backward, the free clearance behind minus the distance driven must be at least 80 pixels; if it does not drive, nothing is required.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

explanation.headline: Unproven: Verus couldn't check any of the 3 rules
explanation.summary: Verus returned 'unknown' for S1, S2 and S3, so none was proved or rejected. It couldn't use the helper function clamp_turn, which sits outside its checked code (or is marked external). Neither battle, open or urban, showed a rule broken, but without a proof that is not evidence the rules hold.
